subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw core accept native backup exclude-pattern flags, and if so what protected-path/default-exclusion policy should the linked implementation follow?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but `.gitignore`-style backup filtering changes a security-sensitive recovery surface and can trade privacy, archive size, and restore completeness against each other.

options.title: Sponsor guarded native exclude support
options.body: Continue with the linked implementation path, but require maintainer-approved protected paths, safe defaults, docs, and real create/verify/restore proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to built-in exclusions only
options.body: Reject general user patterns for now and only add core-owned skips for known rebuildable or volatile state with lower restore-risk blast radius.

options.title: Defer native CLI surface
options.body: Close after documenting the ClawHub workaround if maintainers decide backup policy should remain focused and not add another core CLI option surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guarded native exclude support
recommendation.body: Continue with the linked implementation path, but require maintainer-approved protected paths, safe defaults, docs, and real create/verify/restore proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent backup implementation/docs history and the decision spans backup behavior, security defaults, and user-facing CLI scope.
